faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about removing AI watermarks.

items.question: Is it legal to remove AI watermarks?
items.answer: Removing watermarks for personal use is generally legal in most jurisdictions. However, we recommend checking the terms of service of the specific AI platform and your local laws. Our tool is designed for legitimate use cases such as personal projects and portfolio work.

items.question: Does this tool upload my images to a server?
items.answer: No. All image processing happens 100% locally in your web browser using the Canvas API. Your image data never leaves your device. We don't store, transmit, or have access to any of your images.

items.question: Which AI watermarks can be removed?
items.answer: Currently, we support removing visible watermarks from Google Gemini (the ✦ star logo). Support for DALL-E, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, and Adobe Firefly watermarks is coming in upcoming updates.

items.question: Will removing the watermark affect image quality?
items.answer: Our reverse alpha blending algorithm mathematically recovers the original pixel values, resulting in virtually zero quality loss in the watermark region. The rest of the image remains completely untouched.

items.question: How many images can I process for free?
items.answer: You can process up to 5 images per day completely free. No signup or credit card required. For unlimited processing, our Pro plan starts at just $9/month.

items.question: Does it work on mobile devices?
items.answer: Yes! Our tool works in any modern web browser, including mobile browsers on iOS and Android. The processing is lightweight enough to run smoothly on most smartphones.
